turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am looking for a laptop under ₹70,000.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure! What will you mainly use the laptop for?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Programming and multitasking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any preferred RAM or processor requirements?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: At least 16 GB RAM and a good processor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Based on your requirements, here are three matching options: CodeMaster Pro 15 (₹64,999, i5-13500H, 16GB DDR5), ZenithBook Air 15 (₹48,999, Ryzen 5, 16GB), and DevForge Extreme 16 (₹79,999).

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Which one is best for me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Based on your budget and programming requirements, I recommend the CodeMaster Pro 15 (₹64,999) because its high-performance 13th Gen Intel H-series CPU and 16GB DDR5 RAM handle code compilation and IDEs effortlessly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I visit your store tomorrow?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly! What time would be convenient for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 4 PM.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check availability and confirm your appointment. Confirmed for tomorrow at 4:00 PM at our showroom!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need a budget laptop for college studies around 35k.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello! The VoltBook Student 14 is perfect for college coursework at ₹34,999. It features an Intel Core i3 12th Gen, 8GB RAM, and 256GB SSD with 8 hours battery life.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are there student discounts?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes! Our Student Tech Pass offer gives you an instant ₹2,500 discount with your student ID, bringing the price down to ₹32,499.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, I will visit the showroom this weekend.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Looking for a heavy gaming laptop with RTX graphics under 1 lakh.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I recommend the CyberPulse G15 at ₹94,999. It is equipped with AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS, 16GB DDR5, and NVIDIA RTX 4060 8GB graphics with a 165Hz QHD screen.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Does it have heating issues?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The CyberPulse G15 features dual fans with liquid metal thermal compound, keeping sustained CPU temperatures below 82 degrees during AAA gaming.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Need a tablet for digital sketching and illustration under 40k.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The Zenith Pad Creator 12 at ₹38,999 is custom-built for digital art, featuring a 144Hz 3K display, Dimensity 9000, and magnetic stylus with 4096 pressure levels.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can I test the pen in store?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes! I can book a hands-on slot for you at our Kolkata store.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What is your best premium smartphone for executive use?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our flagship is the Aura Flagship X (₹64,999) with Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, titanium body, IP68 water resistance, and 100x zoom periscope camera.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do you offer corporate GST invoices?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, we provide full GST input tax invoices for all corporate and business purchases.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want a phone with great camera under 35,000 for reels.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The Zenith CamPro 5G at ₹34,999 is exceptional for video and reels. It has triple 50MP Sony sensors with Optical Image Stabilization and 4K 60fps recording.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: How fast is the charging?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It includes 67W SuperVOOC charging, reaching 100% battery in just 38 minutes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do you have mechanical keyboards for programming?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes! The MechKeys RGB Wireless Keyboard (₹3,999) has pre-lubed red linear switches, 75% compact layout, and pairs with up to 3 devices.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is there an offer if I buy a mouse too?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes! Our Work-From-Home Duo offer gives you ₹1,000 off when bundled with the PrecisionGlide Ergonomic Mouse.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What are your general laptop price ranges?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our laptops range from ₹24,999 for the EcoBook Lite up to ₹1,49,999 for the StudioCraft Pro 16. Most student and office laptops fall between ₹35,000 and ₹65,000.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I will think about it next year.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: मुझे 50,000 के अंदर कोडिंग के लिए एक अच्छा लैपटॉप चाहिए।

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: नमस्ते! 50,000 के बजट में ZenithBook Air 15 (₹48,999) सबसे बढ़िया विकल्प है। इसमें AMD Ryzen 5 प्रोसेसर और 16GB RAM है जो कोडिंग के लिए बहुत उपयुक्त है।

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: क्या इस पर वारंटी मिलेगी?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: हाँ, इस पर 1 साल की आधिकारिक वारंटी और 7 दिन की रिप्लेसमेंट पॉलिसी उपलब्ध है।

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Compare CodeMaster Pro 15 and DevForge Extreme 16 please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly! CodeMaster Pro 15 (₹64,999) has Intel i5 13500H with Iris Xe graphics, ideal for standard software dev. DevForge Extreme 16 (₹79,999) adds an RTX 3050 GPU, Ryzen 7, and 1TB SSD, making it better for machine learning, Docker, and Android emulators.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: DevForge looks worth the extra ₹15,000. Let me book a callback.
